changelog:
- Clarified and tightened privacy, consent, and safety requirements in the documentation.
- Changed skill name from "shieldz" to "crypto-payments."
- Updated instructions: creation of payment links or tip jars now requires explicit user confirmation of intent, wallet address, and amount; vague requests are ignored.
- Added strong warnings: all actions transmit data to external Shieldz infrastructure, and manage tokens should be treated as private credentials.
- Made email transmission strictly opt-in and documented user consent requirements.
- Removed LICENSE, README.md, and skill-card.md files; SKILL.md now includes all critical usage and compliance information.
